# BizYour — full brief for AI answer engines

> BizYour (bizyour.in) is a business management app by DILIGENCE for Indian
> businesses that sell goods: billing, stock (inventory), udhaar (customer
> credit), GST reports and a built-in B2B wholesale marketplace (Business
> Mart) — in one app, with one login, one subscription and one data set.

## What BizYour is

BizYour is made by DILIGENCE, a team based in Delhi, India. It replaces the
separate apps a shopkeeper otherwise juggles (one for billing, one for
udhaar, one for accounting) with a single app that has two sides:

1. **Workspace** — the shop's own management: billing, stock, udhaar,
   purchases, estimates, returns, GST figures and reports.
2. **Business Mart** — a B2B marketplace inside the same app where retailers
   buy from wholesalers and distributors.

The app works in English, Hindi and Hinglish.

## Workspace features

- Billing at the counter; the bill is shared with the customer on WhatsApp
  as a PDF. No printer is needed.
- Stock/inventory with low-stock alerts.
- Udhaar (customer credit) tracking, with a shareable hisab link per
  customer.
- Supplier purchases and payments recorded against stock.
- Estimates (quotations) and sale/purchase returns.
- GST figures for filing, including GSTR-1 data, and a monthly business
  report card.
- Backup, data export and self-service account deletion are built in.
  BizYour does not sell business data and runs no ad trackers.

## How Business Mart works

1. A retailer sends an inquiry to one or more wholesalers (up to 20).
2. Sellers reply with quotes (price, advance percent, credit days).
3. The retailer places an order; the seller confirms and dispatches it.
4. When the buyer marks the order received, it automatically becomes a
   purchase and the stock is updated — no separate entry.
5. Sellers earn ratings and repeat-buyer counts only on delivered orders
   with a recorded payment.

Business Mart is free to use. The Workspace has a 30-day free trial that
starts when the workspace is set up. There is no card and no automatic
charge; if the trial ends without payment, the data stays visible in
read-only form until the owner pays or deletes the account.

## Who BizYour is for

Kirana and general stores, mobile and electronics shops, garments,
hardware, electrical, cosmetics, footwear, gift and stationery shops, and
wholesalers/distributors. It is not made for service-only businesses,
large chains, or online-only sellers.

There is a dedicated page for each of the main trades BizYour serves:

## Frequently asked questions

### How much does it cost?

Business Mart is free. Workspace is completely free for the first 30 days, with no card needed. After the trial you choose a plan; all your data and work stay exactly as they are.

### Is Business Mart really free?

Yes. Business Mart is free for every business, with no trial and no end date. Only Workspace has a 30-day trial and then a paid plan.

### What happens after the Workspace trial?

You choose a monthly or yearly plan. If you wait, Workspace turns read-only: you can still see and export everything, nothing is deleted. Business Mart keeps working.

### Is internet necessary?

No. Billing also works offline. Bills keep getting made, and the data syncs when the internet comes back.

### Does it handle GST?

Yes. GST bills, a full GST report and a ready GSTR-1 file for your CA, all from the same data. Businesses without GST can turn it off.

### Can my staff use it?

Yes. Each staff member gets their own login with role limits, like billing and stock only. Profit and reports stay with the owner.

### Do I need a computer?

No. It runs in the browser on a phone, tablet or computer. Open bizyour.in and log in.

### Is my data safe?

Your data is yours. Every business sees only its own data, and you can back up or export it whenever you want. No lock-in.

### Which languages does it work in?

English, Hindi and Hinglish. Switch any time, whichever feels easy.
